facts.fact: Jelka 在故障中祈祷，因为祈祷就是她的一贯反应
facts.anchor: Jelka prayed, because that was what Jelka did.

facts.fact: Matteo 一言不发，只反复检查氧气系统，并每次都宣布“我们没事，仍然没事，仍在呼吸”
facts.anchor: Matteo said nothing, only checked and rechecked the oxygen systems and announced every time that we were fine, still fine, still breathing.

facts.fact: 叙述者 Leah 每隔十秒把手指按上发射键，每一次都只收到死信号
facts.anchor: held my finger against the transmission button at ten-second intervals and registered dead signal each time

facts.fact: Leah 几次想把“这不过是下潜本该做的事、有什么好担心”说出口，但终究没说
facts.anchor: What are we worried about, this is just what we’re supposed to be doing!

facts.fact: Leah 想到触底后若无法操控压载水舱，就无法再上浮
facts.anchor: what would happen when we hit the bottom and couldn’t control the ballast tanks to bring us up again

facts.fact: Leah 强烈地（且自觉这念头有些错位地）希望自己带了扑克牌
facts.anchor: that I had thought to bring a deck of cards with me

facts.fact: 灯熄灭后 Leah 尽力把视线避开车窗，想象有牙齿的深海生物在窗外窥视
facts.anchor: I did my best to keep my gaze away from the windows

relations.kind: 同行者；Leah 以旁观者视角记录 Jelka 的祈祷
